## Overview

This 2026-09-15 [[adyen]] Docs snapshot is the landing guide for Adyen's NetSuite payments bundle across online, in-app and in-person payments, plus a separate reconciliation bundle. It lists capabilities and routes to setup guides; it does not state a bundle release version, current compatibility matrix, merchant enablement, or a completed payment or bank reconciliation result. [[adyen-netsuite]]

## Key takeaways

- Listed payment features include website/mobile credit cards collected through the Card Component, dynamic 3DS2, local payment methods, terminal POS, tokenization, Revenue Protect and Adyen-hosted Pay by Link. These are capability descriptions; the page does not establish that every method or feature is enabled for every merchant, NetSuite configuration, channel or market. Its Card Component statement says reduced PCI DSS requirements, not that PCI duties disappear.
- The reconciliation bundle is described as pulling an Adyen Settlement Detail Report, matching NetSuite transactions using PSP reference and record type, and creating deposits to NetSuite accounts. The page calls this fully automated bank reconciliation, but gives no mapping/error/exception rules or transaction-level verification. A NetSuite deposit record is distinct from a receiving-bank credit.
- Preparation routes through Adyen's get-started guide and test-account creation. After creating the test account, the page instructs enabling Chargeback Management in the NetSuite environment; integration can start on test while a live-account application awaits approval. It then links setup for the test Customer Area, NetSuite Customer Center, Pay by Link, POS and tokenization. The linked guides own credentials, roles, deployment and environment-specific steps.
- The glossary distinguishes a **sales order** commitment (no payment request until goods are shipped or services delivered, then invoice or cash sale), an **invoice** payment request after fulfillment, a **cash sale** for immediate payment at delivery, and a **customer deposit** for advance payment. These NetSuite record descriptions must not be treated as evidence that Adyen authorized, captured, settled or paid out a specific transaction.

quotes.text: Use Adyen's NetSuite bundles to offer online, in-app, and in-person payments.

Sensitive cardholder data is collected securely using our [Card Component](/payment-methods/cards/web-component), which reduces your [PCI DSS-compliance](/get-started-with-adyen/adyen-glossary/#pci-compliance) requirements.

The bundle pulls in an Adyen [Settlement Detail Report](/reporting/settlement-reconciliation/transaction-level/settlement-details-report/) (SDR), uses the [PSP reference](/get-started-with-adyen/adyen-glossary/#psp-reference) and record type to match to transactions in Netsuite, and then creates deposits to Netsuite accounts.
After you have created your test account, enable Chargeback Management in your NetSuite environment.
Sales orders do not initiate payment requests until you have shipped the goods or delivered the service to your shoppers.

## Definition

Adyen's NetSuite payments bundle is a NetSuite integration route described for online, in-app and in-person payment acceptance. The captured landing guide also points to a reconciliation bundle that maps Adyen Settlement Detail Report records to NetSuite transactions using PSP reference and record type, then creates NetSuite account deposit records. [[source-adyen-docs-plugins-netsuite]]

## Scope and lifecycle

The overview lists Card Component, 3DS2, local methods, terminal POS, tokenization, risk tools and Pay by Link as integration capabilities. It routes setup through an Adyen test account, NetSuite Chargeback Management, Customer Area and Customer Center steps, then links payment-channel guides. Its glossary separates a sales-order commitment from invoice or cash-sale payment requests and advance customer deposits. The detailed setup guides own credentials, roles, supported methods and environment-specific behavior.

## Evidence boundary

This is a 2023-modified webpage captured 2026-09-15, without a package version or current compatibility matrix. A listed capability does not establish merchant enablement or a successful payment. The reconciliation description does not prove that an individual NetSuite deposit record matches a receiving-bank credit, or that bank reconciliation completed without exceptions.
